method: Authors: everyone with at least one article in JAE, JAR, TAR, CAR or RAST published 2021–2026, from OpenAlex and the journals' own issue lists, 2,952 people.

Pages: the personal website listed on the author's ORCID record, and the faculty profile (plus any personal site or CV it links to) found through a curated list of 148 accounting faculty directories. 1,137 of 2,952 authors had at least one page that could be read (38.5%); the rest list no site we could find, or their pages block automated reading.

A paper is listed only when the page itself attaches a revise-and-resubmit phrase to one of the six journals (for example, “R&R at The Accounting Review”). The exact wording is shown under each entry.
Papers that Crossref or OpenAlex show as already published are removed, and every entry was checked against the live page before it was listed.
Missing or out-of-date entry? Email lius@fit.edu with the page that lists it.
